title: Ontario municipal systems that convert housing targets into completed units
question: Which municipal systems can convert housing targets into completed units?
why_it_matters: Provincial targets and housing demand matter only if municipal planning, servicing, approvals, infrastructure, labor, and financing can convert them into occupied homes.
current_support: FTFN has Ontario housing supply progress, CMHC housing data, Statistics Canada permits, and Toronto AIC as a first municipal application source.
next_action: Use Toronto AIC as the first municipal application source, then add servicing and approval-timeline sources for priority municipalities.
notes: Source added, not resolved. Toronto AIC does not represent all Ontario municipalities.
